mode: self-signed .eml with an injected DNS resolver

publicKeyFromBody.form: uncompressed P-256 point, carried as a pinesign-key: 0x… line in the body

CAVEAT: No sample.eml was provided, so this ran against a message the spike signed itself. It proves the verifier, the relaxed/relaxed canonicalisation, the body hash and the key extraction. It does NOT prove a real provider's signature or real DNS lookup. Drop a real .eml at spikes/dkim/sample.eml and rerun; the script switches to real DNS automatically.
relatedResult: Spike 5d already verifies an RSA-2048 DKIM signature on chain inside an EIP-8141 VERIFY frame for 61,330 gas, so the on-chain half of this path is proven independently of the .eml.
